description: Install gptwol with addon-oauth2-proxy + addon-ssl. Verifies that oauth2-proxy starts in HTTPS mode (because addon-ssl ships internal-CA certs), listens on bearer_listen_port (8443), validates against the Zitadel-registered gptwol-api audience, and locks the upstream gptwol port (5000) to loopback via iptables. zitadel/default is a dependency so the addon's pre_start registers the Bearer-API audience in Zitadel. addon-oidc (the browser-flow OIDC of gptwol's web UI) is covered by gptwol/reconf-oidc — combining both addons in a livetest would force the CLI to do OIDC client_credentials against the port-forwarded Zitadel TLS endpoint (port 1443), which mismatches the internal HTTP-only URL the rewrite assumes. The production setup uses the public auth.ohnewarum.de URL where this mismatch doesn't apply.
